The '''Imperial Garrison''' on [[Carratos]] was the center of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authority on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was abandoned by the Empire. A local military junta, the [[Liberty Movement]], ransacked the garrison and destroyed nearly all the governmental files, including criminal records. As a result, everyone on Carratos was effectively given a clean slate, and the planet descended into chaos.<ref name="EGTPM" />
